description: Carry Workflow Action success output as a structured JSON object or null from runner production through server persistence and consumers, expose named core/process fields, and render structured task output directly in Web task details.

tasks.title: Switch Workflow Action output to a structured runner-server contract
tasks.description: Atomically migrate the runner Action boundary, shared report envelope, and server Workflow boundary from serialized output strings to structured JSON. Convert all built-in Action producers and runner consumers, add object-or-null validation, expose core/process as {stdout, exitCode}, preserve check and AgentJob behavior at their domain boundaries, store TaskRun output directly, and project the same object into setVars, recovery, task references, output/artifact capture, and task status APIs.
acceptanceCriteria: ActionResult success output is typed as JsonObject | null, succeed accepts that shape, and one runtime validator shared by task and check execution rejects a string (including serialized object text), array, scalar, cyclic object, non-finite number, undefined/function/bigint value, or other non-JSON value with an actionable invalid-action-output failure before completion, recovery output matching, artifact capture, or setVars runs; null remains a successful output.

core/process success output is exactly {stdout: <trimmed standard output>, exitCode: <numeric exit code>}; its existing top-level WorkItemResult.exitCode fact remains available, and runner tests prove output.stdout and output.exitCode retain string and number types.

Every other built-in Action returns its established output object directly with unchanged field names, values, and JSON types; production Action paths no longer JSON.stringify successful public output, and their existing tests assert object fields without JSON.parse compatibility helpers.

setVars traverses the Action output object directly and sends one Run Variables PATCH only after all source paths resolve; a core/process task can project output.stdout and output.exitCode, while a missing source path or null output fails the task, names the source path, and applies none of that task's variable patch.

Recovery when: output.* matching, failure.output.* expansion, declared output capture, and dynamic producedArtifacts discovery consume the same Action output object directly with no output-string parsing or wrapping; existing recovery and artifact semantics remain covered by runner tests.

WorkItemResult.output carries JsonValue | null and ServerConnection.report emits nested JSON. RunnerReportRequest.Output, WorkResult.Output, and TaskReport.Output carry JsonElement?; explicit JSON null is canonicalized to nullable null, valid task objects are assigned directly to TaskRun.Output, and ParseOutputToJsonElement plus its string-wrapping fallback are removed.

WorkflowItemTranslator rejects a task report whose output is not an object or null by producing and acknowledging a durable failed task report; it does not apply Workflow object-root validation to checks or AgentJobs.

A completed task's persisted object is projected under tasks.<definitionId>.outputs without conversion, and an integration spec proves a later task resolves ${{ tasks.process.outputs.stdout }} to a string and ${{ tasks.process.outputs.exitCode }} to a number. Historical non-object TaskRun output is neither rewritten nor projected as valid task output.

Check dispatch output is a structured result-row array whose passing rows contain object-or-null Action output, and server check translation consumes the JsonElement array directly. AgentJob report/terminal-output and failure-category behavior remain unchanged through an explicit Agent adapter; focused regression tests cover both shared-envelope variants.

TaskStatusView.Output is JsonElement? and server status/timeline responses expose object-valued TaskRun output as a nested JSON object or null, mapping historical non-object values to null; API/spec tests cover core/process output, another built-in Action output, null output, and invalid report rejection.

The built-in mohist/github-pr profile regression covers its existing setVars fields, task-output references, recovery output matching, and unchanged Action output fields using the structured report contract.

design/workflow/actions.md no longer lists string Action output and core/process bare stdout as an implementation gap; no Action manifest, input validation, output declaration/schema, or new Workflow YAML syntax is introduced.
npm run typecheck -w packages/runner, npm test -w packages/runner, and npm test all pass with no real network, process, filesystem, database service, or wall-clock dependency added to tests.
tasks.output: Structured Action/result types and validation across packages/runner/src/core, actions, runtime, and server connection; JsonElement runner-report and Workflow persistence/projection contract across packages/server; updated runner/server tests and the closed output gap in design/workflow/actions.md
tasks.notes: This is one atomic task because runner and server wire formats are intentionally incompatible in mixed versions. Keep ActionResult.output narrower (JsonObject | null) than shared WorkItemResult.output (JsonValue | null). Key boundaries: packages/runner/src/core/types.ts, actions/action-result.ts, runtime/executor.ts, runtime/check-execution.ts, runtime/set-vars.ts, runtime/recovery.ts, runtime/output-capture.ts, runtime/artifact-capture.ts, server/connection.ts; packages/server Api/RunnerRoutes.cs, Runner/Grains/IRunnerGrain.cs, Runner/Services/WorkflowItemTranslator.cs, Workflow/Domain/Run/WorkItem.cs, Workflow/Grains/WorkflowWorkLifecycle.cs, Workflow/Services/WorkflowDispatchHelpers.cs, Workflow/Services/WorkflowStatusMapper.cs, and AgentJob report handling. Do not wire the currently disconnected capturedOutputs field into the server.

tasks.title: Render structured task output directly in Web workflow views
tasks.description: Migrate Web task timeline and progress models to consume the structured object-or-null API delivered by T-001. Remove JSON-string parsing and compatibility fallbacks from task-output presentation and delivery metadata extraction while preserving the existing structured JSON display and workflow reading flow.
acceptanceCriteria: WorkflowTimelineTask.output and related task-state inputs accept Record<string, unknown> | null (or the repository's equivalent structured JSON type), not string output.

parseTimelineTaskOutput, the TaskProgressPanel-local parseTaskOutput helper, and string JSON parsing fallbacks used for task-output/delivery metadata are removed; StageBar and TaskProgressPanel pass API output directly to the existing structured-output renderer.
A completed core/process task with {stdout: "release-ready", exitCode: 0} displays both fields and their values in every task-detail/progress surface without an intermediate JSON.parse.
Existing built-in PR delivery output remains discoverable from object-valued task output with the same prNumber, prUrl, mergeCommitSha, and targetBranch semantics.
A null output renders no fabricated empty object or wrapped string, and task status, failure guidance, logs, artifacts, and reading-flow layout remain unchanged.

Web unit/spec coverage exercises structured core/process output, structured PR output, and null output in both StageBar and TaskProgressPanel paths; npm run typecheck -w packages/web and npm run test:run -w packages/web pass.
tasks.output: Structured workflow-task output types and direct rendering in packages/web/src/entities/issue, widgets/issue-workflow, and shared delivery metadata helpers, with Web regression tests
tasks.notes: Consumes the TaskStatusView.Output API established by T-001, so it cannot run in parallel. Preserve the current JSON renderer and layout; this task changes the data contract, not the visual design. Key files: packages/web/src/entities/issue/model/workflow-timeline.ts, widgets/issue-workflow/ui/format.ts, StageBar.tsx, TaskProgressPanel.tsx, shared/lib/pr-delivery.ts, and their tests.
